newsitem.title: USA: Pride Petroleum poised for improvements.
newsitem.headline: Pride Petroleum poised for improvements.

text.p: Pride Petroleum Services Inc said on Wednesday that its first quarter results had exceeded expectations and that it foresaw further improvements throughout the year.

"First quarter results surpassed our expectations," said Ray Tolson, chairman and chief executive of the company. "With the inclusion of Forasol-Foramer operations for full periods, as well as higher rates for some of our high-end assets, we believe we are poised for further improvements in operating results throughout the remainder of the year," he added.
Pride Petroleum, a drilling contractor, provides onshore and offshore drilling, workover and related services in more than 15 countries.

Pride Petroleum posted net earnings for the first quarter of 1997 of $44,921,000, or $1.15 per share, on revenues of $131,376,000. That compared to $2,780,000, or $0.11 per share, on revenues of $66,235,000 for the same period in 1996.
